buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The successful party/bidder shall have to strictly follow the below mentioned terms & conditio ns along with the special terms and conditions for Catering Services as laid down on GeM Port al and those as will be laid down in the supply order and ensure smooth service in serving the dietary items to the participants: The dietary items are to be served during the different events and trainings hence t he duration of the programmes, menu and quantity will be intimated to the successful bidder prior to the conduct of the event as laid down in the Supply Order/GeM terms and conditions a nd the quantity shall increase or decrease as per the approved plans by the Competent Author ities. Any increase or decrease in the quantity/number of servings shall be intimated to the su pplier well in time and payments shall be made against actual number of servings. 1. Service Provider shall possess a valid license with kind of business as “Food Services – Cater er” issued by Food Safety & Standard Authority of India (FSSAI), State Govt./Central Govt., PA N and copy of GST registration certificate from appropriate authority. 2. To claim exemptions (EMD, Experience, and Turnover) on GeM, the bidder must upload valid supporting documents in the respective exemption slots during bid submission. Missing a doc ument—or uploading one with mismatched details—leads to technical rejection.

3. The crockery used shall be clean, not old or faulty (Cracked, scratched); the packaged food p ackets (If required) should not leak, and the cloth and paper napkins provided should be clean . 4. The eatables served by the Service Provider to the participants/guests shall be completely h ygienic, free from any sort of adulteration or foreign ingredients. 5. The items have to be delivered at DIET Beerwah Budgam or outside in the Zones of District B udgam as and when required. 6. The bidder/s must submit an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) / CDR amounting Rs. 50000 (Rupe es Fifty Thousand only) pledged to the Principal, DIET Beerwah. Physical CDR/DD must be dep osited at the office before bid opening. 7. The payment shall be made after receipt of the supplies in full. 8. Rates quoted shall be including of all taxes and service charges. 9. Successful bidder shall produce Tax Clearance Certificate before receiving Supply Order. 10. In case any of the dietary item is found to be substandard, it would not be accepted and the bond shall be forfeited with immediate effect and action as warranted under relevant provisio ns of law will be initiated against successful bidder. 11. This bond shall remain in force for the Financial Year 2026-27only. 12. Bid Estimated Value is subject to the availability of budget and number of participants during the session. 13. In case of failure to deliver items within the stipulated timeframe or non-compliance with qua lity standards, the supply order will be cancelled without issuance of any notice. Items will be procured from the open market at the risk and cost of the defaulting supplier, EMD/Performan ce Security will be forfeited, and the supplier will be blacklisted with immediate effect. 14. An undertaking duly attested by Judicial Magistrate First Class should be furnished by the Su ccessful Bidder to the effect that the dietary items will be of standard quality and delivered o n time on already approved rates. 15. The undersigned reserves the right to cancel the tender or forfeit the bid at any point upon a dministrative reasons. .
